editorial.tldr: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 appeared as a name before any model shipped, on Oct 16. The same day, a report said China's planned export license for new large AI models could affect its unreleased launch.
editorial.whats_new: TestingCatalog reports Kimi K3.1 is being prepared for release after Arena testing, and a Kimi K3.1 Pro explainer on benchmarks and pricing followed the same day.
editorial.why_it_matters: A possible export-license requirement plus an unreleased model means availability, API access and pricing for K3.1 are unconfirmed, so it is not yet a safe dependency.
editorial.take_for_builders: Do not wire K3.1 into production yet; keep your current model as fallback and rerun your own evals once Moonshot confirms availability, pricing and license terms.

status.detail: K3.1 is reportedly in Arena testing and nearing release; no confirmed official launch appears in these items.
